samir: EDR alert on DEV-005 (Windows 10) — agent flagged a registry autorun write to HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run by C:\Users\samir\AppData\Local\Temp\upd-agent.exe. File quarantined. Alert tags: persistence, network. Event id 0x7f2a. Can security triage?
EDR-Bot: Alert 0x7f2a — file quarantined. SHA256: abcd1234ef567890... (truncated). First seen 2026-03-20T10:01:25Z. Outbound TLS to 18.197.23.11:443 blocked. No policy bypass noted.
maria: looping in infra and SRE. samir, what's the asset tag and did you install anything today?
samir: asset DEV-005. I pulled a nightly helper from internal CI around 09:40 and executed it (`curl -sS ci.redwood/internal/latest.exe -o upd.exe && upd.exe`). Thought it was our CI helper.
ashley: quick checks: get file hash, check signature, `strings` for C2 indicators, and check for child processes. Also verify any KMS activity from that host. If it spawned `rundll32` or `mshta` children, isolate.
samir: quick run outputs:
```
PS> Get-FileHash C:\Users\samir\AppData\Local\Temp\upd-agent.exe -Algorithm SHA256
Hash : abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890
PS> sigcheck upd-agent.exe
Signed: No
Processes observed: upd-agent.exe -> powershell.exe -> mshta.exe
```
EDR shows TLS handshake to 18.197.23.11 within 30s of execution.
neil: @maria can you check KMS logs for any activity from DEV-005 during that window? Also check for SSH agent sockets or new keys on the host.
maria: KMS logs: no requests from that host in that timeframe. SSH agent not present. I'll pull CI artifact provenance and who signed that build.
ashley: action plan: 1) isolate host network (block egress) 2) full disk and memory capture 3) collect autoruns + scheduled tasks + registry Run keys 4) pause CI distribution for that artifact until we verify signatures. samir please stop using the machine.
EDR-Bot: Isolation initiated by ashley at 2026-03-20T10:04:10Z. Quarantine artifact id a-7765 attached.
marco: IT attempted phone contact, user responded and handed laptop over at 10:12. We'll image disk and deliver to forensics.
samir: confirmed — powered down and disconnected NIC. Sorry folks.
ashley: Forensics: capture memory image, `autoruns` output, `schtasks /query /fo LIST /v`, and list HKCU and HKLM Run keys. If persistence present, reimage is preferred. Also review CI signing keys and rotate if artifact provenance unclear.
maria: ticket SEC-2026-413 opened, assigned to ashley and forensics. Notifying product about potential pause of the nightly helper deployment.
samir: sorry about this — won't run helper builds on my workstation until cleared. :grimacing:
ashley: Post-incident TODOs: 1) full forensics report 2) CI artifact integrity check + sig verification 3) rotate build credentials if needed 4) asset reimage checklist. I'll update this thread with findings. :eyes:
